snippet.title: Ghost House 3D [Trailer]
snippet.description:
A haunted first-person horror roguelike. Fight bats, zombies, Draculas and worse across five floors of procedurally generated mansion. Stack upgrades, raid shops, gamble your gold and face MEGA-DRAC on the rooftop.

Play free: https://johnreno.itch.io/ghost-house-3d
